notes.title: The Last Days of Sodom - Major Update - Summer 2022
notes.notes:
- A choice of three player main character, Male, Female and Valkyrie
- Three difficulty levels
- Improved animation for main character, turn in place, shoot up and down
- Improved enemies
- Bugs fixed

notes.title: 2022 Major Update
notes.notes:
A choice of three different main characters, Male, Female and Valkyrie
Three different levels of difficulty
Improved Enemies
Bugs fixed

notes.title: Update notes for January 15th 2022
notes.notes:
Removed Faulty Achievement System


Addressed video/audio sync issues


Further work on animations of Angel Foot Soldiers and Angel Champion


Improvements to Sodomite civilians animations

notes.title: The Last Days of Sodom, January 9th 2022 Patch
notes.notes:
Up dated and improved animation for Angel Foot Soldiers and Angel Champion.


 Health power-ups have limited life-span


 Basic achievement system (resets with new game)


 Enemy killed counter (resets with new game)


 Some bugs fixed
